correctStatements.text: At 19:12 Rafael was paged when the checkout error rate reached 14 percent against a 2 percent threshold.
At 19:15 Ingrid found many timeout acquiring connection messages in the application logs.
Kwame reported that about one in seven carts failed at the payment step.
At 19:21 Ingrid noted the pool maximum was 40 per pod and every connection was in use on every pod.
Noor identified a slow reporting query, present since the 18:50 deploy, holding connections for minutes.
At 19:28 Noor started killing the long-running database sessions.
At 19:31 Rafael saw the error rate fall to 3 percent and keep dropping.
At 19:36 Kwame rolled back the 18:50 release as a precaution.
At 19:44 Rafael stood down after the error rate stayed under 0.5 percent for eight minutes.
Noor will move the reporting query to the read replica.
Ingrid will set a 30 second statement timeout on the application database role.
Kwame will add connection pool saturation to the dashboard.
Rafael summarised that a slow reporting query from the 18:50 deploy starved the connection pool and broke checkout for about 32 minutes.
